ARTICLE 2 SCOPE OF SERVICES Section 2.1 Engagement. (a) Owner hereby engages Manager during the Term to act as the sole and exclusive manager and operator of the Facilities, subject to and as more fully described in this Agreement and, in connection therewith, to perform the services described in Exhibit A attached hereto.

This Agreement establishes the duty and responsibility of the Manager to manage, operate and maintain the Facilities, including to oversee (but not perform itself) the provision of food and beverage services at the Facilities (provided that catering services ( “Catering Services ”) do not fall within the Manager ’s operational duties unless otherwise expressly stated and must be performed within the confines of Owner ’s catering policy; and concession services, defined as the sale of food and beverages from permanent and temporary food stands that serve the public (“Concession Services ”), do fall within the Manager ’s operational duties unless otherwise expressly stated and may be operated in-house, outsourced to a third party, or a combination of both), and to oversee and be responsible for the security and coordination of traffic and parking for certain parking facilities during the use of the Center or the Ice Arena as described in Operations Manual.
Any person dealing with the Manager has the right to rely on the Manager's authority to the extent prescribed in this Agreement.

The Manager shall not have authority to (i) encumber any real or personal property owned by the Owner, nor (ii) obligate the Owner for anything outside the scope of this Agreement. (b) Manager hereby accepts such engagement, and shall perform the services described herein, subject to the limitations expressly set forth in this Agreement and in the Operations Manual.
Section 2.2 Limitations on Manager’s Duties.
Manager’s obligations under this Agreement are contingent upon and subject to the Owner making available, in a timely fashion, the funds budgeted for and/or reasonably required by Manager to carry out such obligations during the Term.
Manager shall not be considered to be in breach or default of this Agreement, and shall have no liability to the Owner or any other party, in the event Manager does not perform any of its obligations hereunder due to failure by the Owner to timely provide such funds.
ARTICLE 3 COMPENSATION Section 3.1 Fixed Management Fee.
In consideration of Manager’s performance of its services hereunder, Owner shall pay Manager a Fixed Management Fee.

Beginning on the Effective Date and continuing through June 30, 2030, the Fixed Management Fee shall be Two Hundred Five Thousand Four Hundred Eighty-Nine Dollars ($205,489.00) per year, paid monthly – based on each Facility as follows:

The parties shall then engage in good faith discussions and use reasonable commercial efforts to attempt to resolve the matter to the mutual satisfaction of the parties, including, if applicable, negotiation of a mutually acceptable modification to the economic terms of this Agreement to enable the Manager to achieve the compensation contemplated by its proposed Operating Budget.

12 4920-4464-0326.3 Section 7.3 Adherence to Operating Budget.
Manager shall use all reasonable efforts to manage and operate the Facilities in accordance with the Operating Budget.

ARTICLE 8 PROCEDURE FOR HANDLING INCOME Section 8.1 Event Account.
Manager shall deposit as soon as practical, upon receipt, but not less than once each business day, in the Event Account, all revenue received from ticket sales and similar event-related revenues which Manager receives in contemplation of, or arising from, an event, pending completion of the event.
Such monies will be held in escrow for the protection of ticket purchasers, the Owner, the Manager, and to provide a source of funds as required for payments to performers in connection with the presentation of events that must be paid prior to or contemporaneously with such events.
Promptly following completion of such event and settlement with Promoter, Manager shall transfer all funds remaining in the Event Account into the Operating Account.
Section 8.2 Operating Account.
Except as provided in Section 8.1, all Revenue and reimbursements (e.g., URI Athletic Box Office share) derived from operation of the Facilities shall be deposited by Manager into the Operating Account as soon as practical, upon receipt, but not less often than once each business day.

The specific procedures (and authorized individuals) for making deposits to and withdrawals from such account shall be set forth in the Operations Manual, but the parties specifically agree that Manager shall have authority to sign checks and make withdrawals from such account, subject to the limitations contained in this Agreement, without needing to obtain the co-signature of an Owner employee or representative.
Section 8.3 Event Marketing Fund Account.

13 4920-4464-0326.3 will the Event Marketing Fund Account exceed the $400,000 balance as of the date hereof, and in no event is Manager required to contribute any additional funds from its own account to the Fund, or otherwise to pay for any event losses or Operating Expenses with its own funds.

The Owner shall, upon request by Manager which requests shall be made three (3) times per Operating Year or on an as-needed basis following the Effective Date, deposit in the Operating Account the budgeted or otherwise approved expenses for funding needed.
Manager shall have no liability to the Owner or any third party in the event Manager is unable to perform its obligations hereunder, or under any third party contract entered into pursuant to the terms hereof, due to the fact that sufficient funds are not made available to Manager to pay such expenses in a timely manner.

Under no circumstances shall Manager be required to pay for or advance any of its own funds to pay for any Operating Expenses.

14 4920-4464-0326.3 shall immediately pay to Manager the unamortized amount of Manager's Contribution as calculated herein.

Manager agrees to provide to the Owner, within thirty (30) days after the end of each month during the Term, financial reports for the Facilities including a balance sheet, statement of cash flow, aging report on accounts receivable and accounts payable, and statement of revenues and expenditures (budget to actual) for such month and year to date in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles.
In addition, Manager agrees to provide to the Owner a summary of bookings for each such month, and separate cash receipts and disbursements reports for each event held at the Facilities during such month.
Additionally, Manager shall submit to the Owner, on a monthly basis, copies of all bank statements and reconciliations concerning the Event Account and the Operating Account.

Such procedures, developed and agreed upon by the Owner and Manager, when performed and reported on by an independent practitioner, will provide assurance that the financial statements and procedures are sufficient and comply with the applicable reporting framework per this Agreement.

15 4920-4464-0326.3 Costs associated with obtaining such an attestation report shall be an Operating Expense of the Facilities.

This contract represents ongoing support services that are part of the current operations of the campus for providing food and paper products to the University’s Dining Services operations.
Recommendation: It is recommended that the University of Rhode Island Board of Trustees approve the proposed Change Order to the PFG Contract.
Points to Consider: This contract was initially awarded in 2020, but first approved by the Board of Trustees in September of 2023.
Currently the contract value is approved for $34 million.
The original contract has been renewed multiple times.

This will be the last extension before the contract goes out to bid again.
A similar contract extension and increase was previously approved by the Board in June 2025 for $6.5M to extend and increase the contract.
This proposed increase of $6.2M to the contract value will cover additional expenses for the final year of the contract.
This estimate is consistent with the prior spend of this contract.
